account.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action cannot be undone.

preview.title: Test as new user
preview.description: Creates a temporary sandbox profile. All data (log, weight, calibration) is automatically deleted when you exit. Your real account is not affected.
preview.activeInfo: You are now navigating as a new user. The banner at the top confirms the mode.
preview.exit: Exit preview and delete test data

dataExport.title: Export my data
dataExport.description: Download all your personal information in machine-readable format (JSON or CSV). You have this right under GDPR.
dataExport.info: The file contains: profile, meals, measurements, and consents.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.warning: Deleting your account will permanently remove all your data. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirm: Are you absolutely sure? Type "delete" below to confirm.
deleteAccount.final: This is irreversible. Type "delete account" to confirm permanently.
